extra.label: FMS 2026 catalysts: HBF standard (SK Hynix + SanDisk), HBM 2026 fully sold out, V10 375-layer 4D NAND — three new product/market confirmations overnight
extra.value: Flash Memory Summit (FMS 2026), Hot Springs, Virginia, produced three SK Hynix-specific catalysts that were released while Korean investors were preparing for Wednesday's KRX open: (1) HBF STANDARD: SK Hynix and SanDisk co-authored and announced the HBF (High Bandwidth Flash) standard — a new memory tier between HBM (DRAM-based, high cost) and enterprise SSDs (storage-class, lower bandwidth) that addresses the AI inference memory bandwidth bottleneck. HBF is positioned as the 'middle tier' of the AI memory hierarchy, potentially as large a market as HBM itself over 3–5 years. SK Hynix co-leading the standard positions it as a primary beneficiary of HBF market creation (alongside SanDisk/Western Digital). (2) HBM 2026 SOLD OUT: SK Hynix confirmed at FMS 2026 that its entire 2026 HBM production capacity is fully sold out, and 2027 HBM4 capacity is already being allocated. This removes any remaining inventory-risk concern for H2 2026 and provides direct revenue visibility for Q3 2026 earnings. (3) V10 375-LAYER 4D NAND: SK Hynix unveiled the V10 chip, a 375-layer 4D NAND Flash with industry-leading density, extending technology leadership beyond HBM into storage — relevant to the HBF standard context. None of these catalysts were priced into the ₩1,867,213 framework gate when it was set (July 30) — they represent incremental upside pressure toward and potentially through the gate.

extra.label: SKHY US ADR +8.17% to $154.38 — ADR premium expands to ~28% (widest of the post-earnings period); arb buying pressure intensifying
extra.value: The SKHY US ADR closed at $154.38 (+8.17%) on Wednesday's US session — outperforming the KRX's +5.77% because the ADR was also pricing in FMS 2026 catalysts and sector-wide semiconductor strength (NVDA +4.3%, AMD beat). At the KRX close of ₩1,668,000: ₩1,668,000 / 10 ADR units / 1,380 KRW/USD ≈ $120.87 per ADR-equivalent. SKHY US at $154.38 → premium = ($154.38 − $120.87) / $120.87 ≈ 27.7% ≈ ~28%. This is the widest ADR premium since the post-earnings period began (Tuesday was ~22.5%). The expanding premium is mechanically bullish for the KRX: arb traders purchase 000660.KS (the 'cheap' KRX shares) while selling SKHY (the 'expensive' US ADR). At 28% premium, the arb has become the most attractive entry since July 31, creating intensified mechanical buy pressure on the KRX side heading into Thursday's session.

analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — hammer confirmed; V-recovery in progress; ₩1,718,000 within striking distance

SK Hynix (000660.KS) closed ₩1,668,000 on 2026-08-05, up ₩91,000 / +5.77% from Tuesday's ₩1,577,000 close. Daily candle structure: gap-up open (~₩1,650,000), session high ₩1,701,000, session low ₩1,647,000, close ₩1,668,000. Intraday range: ₩54,000 (3.2%) — sharply narrower than Tuesday's ₩147,000 (9.9%) hammer session. The KRX session ran 00:00–06:30 UTC (9:00am–3:30pm KST).

### Post-earnings recovery scorecard (five sessions)

| Session | KRX Close | vs. Pre-Earn. (₩1,550K) | vs. July 30 Entry (₩1,322K) |
|---|---|---|---|
| July 31 | ₩1,718,000 | +₩168K / +10.8% | +₩396K / +30.0% |
| Aug 3 | ₩1,567,000 | +₩17K / +1.1% | +₩245K / +18.5% |
| Aug 4 | ₩1,577,000 | +₩27K / +1.7% | +₩255K / +19.3% |
| **Aug 5** | **₩1,668,000** | **+₩118K / +7.6%** | **+₩346K / +26.2%** |

Key observation: the two-session geopolitical selloff (Aug 3 −7.9%, Aug 4 net +0.64%) from the July 31 peak has been substantially reversed in a single session. Today's close of ₩1,668,000 is the highest of the post-earnings consolidation period (excluding July 31). The July 31 close (₩1,718,000) is only ₩50,000 / +3.0% away.

### Trend — hammer confirmed; V-recovery; ₩1,718,000 reclamation imminent

The August 4 'hammer' candlestick (long lower shadow, close above ₩1,550,000 thesis floor) required Wednesday follow-through to confirm bottom formation. Today delivered a gap-up open with consistent buying and a tight intraday range (₩54,000 / 3.2%) — institutional conviction buying, not volatile recovery. The hammer is confirmed.

The three-session V-recovery arc: Aug 3 panic low ₩1,483,000 → Aug 4 hammer close ₩1,577,000 → Aug 5 close ₩1,668,000 (+₩185,000 / +12.5% from panic trough in two sessions). This pace of recovery is driven by a rare convergence of technical confirmation (hammer), macro tailwind (ADP miss), and new fundamental catalysts (FMS 2026 HBF standard, HBM sold out).

### Volume — elevated; directionally bullish; institutional conviction signal

Volume was above the 3-month average for the third consecutive session, but today's character differs sharply from Tuesday: where Tuesday's ₩147,000 intraday range reflected volatile two-way action (gap-up, crash, recovery), today's ₩54,000 range on a +5.77% session reflects one-directional institutional accumulation. The KOSPI all-time high context (+3.76% to 6,598.26) amplified broad-based institutional buying of Korean equities following the ADP 44K miss removing the Korean export sector's primary macro headwind (Fed hike risk → dollar strength).

### ★ Strongest support — ₩1,550,000 (pre-earnings reference / thesis-validity floor)

Evidence for ★ designation:
1. Thesis-defining level: defined in the August 3 dossier as the level below which 'the post-earnings re-rating is fully unwound'
2. Today's close ₩1,668,000 is ₩118,000 / +7.6% above — the most comfortable thesis-validity buffer of the five post-earnings sessions
3. Three consecutive closing sessions above ₩1,550,000 (Aug 3 ₩1,567,000, Aug 4 ₩1,577,000, Aug 5 ₩1,668,000) establish a base pattern
4. Former resistance: ₩1,550,000 was the ceiling before Q2 earnings; each session above it adds to institutional memory as support
5. The August 3 intraday breach (₩1,483,000 low) was bought aggressively — investors who bought at ₩1,483,000–₩1,520,000 are now +12.5%–+9.7% in profit, providing a large cushion above ₩1,550,000

### ★ Strongest resistance — ₩1,867,213 (framework gate / primary medium-term target)

Evidence:
1. Primary medium-term target; October Q3 2026 earnings (first HBM4 H2 revenue recognition) is the specific catalyst
2. The gap has narrowed: 8.7% (July 31) → 18.4% (Aug 4) → 11.9% (Aug 5) — the gate is closing but remains a multi-session objective
3. FMS 2026 catalysts (HBF standard, HBM sold out) add incremental upside pressure not priced into the gate when it was set on July 30
4. Above the gate: ₩2,987,000 (52-week high) and the analyst consensus target (₩3,189,340, +91.2% upside) represent the structural long-term ceiling

### Decision points for Thursday and beyond

**1. Thursday KRX open relative to ₩1,701,000 (today's high) and ₩1,718,000 (July 31 close)**
The primary near-term test: does Thursday close above ₩1,718,000 (completing the V-recovery) or does it produce a 'lower high' below ₩1,701,000 (suggesting near-term resistance)?

**2. NFP (August 7, 8:30am ET) — the week's remaining macro binary**
Soft NFP (consistent with ADP 44K) → global risk-on continuation, KOSPI strength, push toward ₩1,867,213. Hot NFP surprise → risk-off, potential KOSPI pullback, test of ₩1,647,000–₩1,668,000 as support for Thursday/Friday sessions.

**3. Framework gate gap — from 18.4% (Aug 4) to 11.9% (Aug 5)**
At today's recovery pace (roughly ₩91,000 per session), the gate is mathematically ~2.2 sessions away — though the final stretch will require a catalyst beyond daily macro drift. NFP soft print + continued sector strength is the path to testing the gate before October earnings.

### What invalidates the bull read

A KRX closing price below ₩1,550,000 (pre-earnings reference) would signal the post-earnings re-rating has been fully unwound — BUY thesis must be re-evaluated. Note: the FMS 2026 catalysts (HBF standard, HBM sold out) add a new fundamental floor that did not exist during the Aug 3–4 selloff — any future selloff to ₩1,550,000 would now require discounting both the pre-earnings re-rating AND the new FMS 2026 catalysts to sustain a close below the floor. A close below ₩1,450,000 (July 29 post-earnings bounce) would require fundamental re-assessment of HBM4 demand — not a current scenario given FMS 2026 HBM sold-out confirmation and SKHY ADR premium holding at 28%.
